jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst - Health Insurance (Fully Remote)
QA Manager
jobs.description:
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us
Lead and shape the QA function at the AI-native insurance platform of choice for the world's leading insurers
100% remote, with a global, diverse team
Own quality strategy for a fast-growing product suite, with a direct line to the Head of QA and real influence over how we build
About Us
At CoverGo, our mission is to empower all insurance companies to make insurance 100% digital and accessible to everyone.
We are a leading global no-code insurance platform for health, life, and P&C
We're the winner of the Insurtech of the Year in all of Asia and other awards globally
We work with insurance enterprise clients such as AXA, Bupa, MSIG, Dai-ichi, Bank of China Group Insurance, and many more
We're an international, diverse team of over 120 people with 30 nationalities and team members working remotely from all over the world
We are fully funded and backed by reputable VC funds and strategic institutional investors
We have a global presence in Asia, EMEA and the Americas
We've grown our annualized revenue by over 30x since January 2021
We're constantly working towards making CoverGo a workplace that you love coming to. We deeply believe that bringing together a diversity of thoughts, expressions, and perspectives is key to building the best culture for equally diverse communities all over the world
What You Will Do
Strategy, Process & Governance
Provide full oversight of the testing lifecycle across multiple teams and projects, defining and enforcing QA processes and standardizing tools, environments, and test coverage organization-wide
Establish and continuously refine QA processes, procedures, and standards for testing products before they go to market
Ensure scalable test infrastructure, and extend our testing capability into advanced domains including performance, security, and compliance testing
Identify systemic quality gaps and cross-team risks, run trend analysis on quality metrics, and anticipate issues that could affect release stability or timelines
Evaluate and resolve organizational blockers in QA workflows, balancing trade-offs and delivery timelines while protecting stakeholder satisfaction
Deliver executive-level QA insights — reports, dashboards, and strategic recommendations — to the Head of QA and cross-functional leadership
Team Leadership
Manage and mentor QA Leads and senior individual contributors, fostering career growth, succession planning, and technical leadership across the QA organization
Distribute workload, set goals for QA Leads and their teams, and conduct performance reviews across the function
Drive continuous performance evaluation and improvement of QA teams — resolving conflicts, supporting morale, and building a culture of ownership, accountability, and excellence
Be the advocate for Agile testing and quality across the business, building quality awareness at every stage of the product lifecycle
Execution & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Oversee QA engineers and Leads testing our products and implementing automation across cross-functional teams
Partner closely with engineering, product, and business analysts to shape requirements and comprehensive testing strategies
Participate in reviews of software requirements, design documents, and system architecture, ensuring testing requirements are addressed early
Manage and triage reported defects, and keep visibility over how features delivered by other teams interact across subsystems
Continuously improve and refactor our testing infrastructure and automated/regression frameworks to ensure reliability and scalability
What We Need
Experience & Leadership
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
8+ years of experience in software QA spanning both manual and automated testing of web and API applications, including at least 2+ years directly managing QA Leads, senior engineers, or a multi-team QA function
Experience in the insurance or a similarly regulated, complex industry is a strong plus
Proven track record establishing QA processes, tooling, and standards organization-wide, not just within a single team
Experience navigating executive-level reporting — comfortable turning quality metrics into insights and recommendations for senior leadership
Technical Depth
Deep understanding of software testing methodologies, tools, and processes across the full testing lifecycle
Experience implementing and scaling automated testing frameworks in an agile environment, with deep understanding of BDD and Gherkin
Hands-on familiarity with testing tools for JavaScript and .NET such as Jest, Mocha, JMeter, Cypress, Selenium, Puppeteer, NUnit, Cucumber, Telerik, Specflow, or similar, and how to integrate them with CI
Proficient with defect tracking and test management tooling, with strong experience setting up QA processes and running structured performance reviews
Working knowledge of performance, security, and compliance testing domains
Practical experience building and rolling out AI-powered processes across teams or workflows
Why You'll Love Working Here
100% Remote Work
15 Days of Annual Leave
Annual Performance Bonus
Remote Work Allowance
Anniversary Bonus
Health Insurance
Stock Options after 6 months
Company Activities and Events
Learning and Development Plan
CoverGo Company Video

jobs.title: Senior QA Test Automation Engineer (Java)
jobs.description:
Reason to join us:
• We offer the opportunity to work in a highly professional environment where you will work with high-level financial instruments
• We want you to be part of our success story and give you reasons to be proud of what you achieved as part of our fabulous team
• We allow you to develop yourself and evolve in your career via our fantastic technical, business-related, or soft-skills training
• We encourage creative thinking in our great open-minded work environment. Frequently the relaxation rooms are the place where the most ambitious ideas are born.
• We are not just professional teams, we are also friends who have fun working together
• If you are an active person and you feel motivated by the creation/development of software solutions, then this is the place to be, you will not get bored.
Project description:
VR-120329
The client, an investment bank is renewing its workflow automation technology. The project it's a new platform aiming at simplifying business process interactions and automation by using modern technologies specific to this domain.
The core of the platform is managing all platform business processes and providing core functionalities, libraries, indexing, data enhancement, and user interaction to onboarded use cases. The goal is to have high availability and high-performance platform infrastructure with a focus on fast business adoption with low downtimes. Core technologies are Java, Camunda, Spring, Hibernate, and Elasticsearch deployed on OpenShift/Kubernetes environments and automated by E2E CI/CD pipelines.
Responsibilities:
Ability to plan and implement the full set of test automation activities: create, maintain, and execute automated tests.
Develop, extend, and improve the existing Test Automation tools and test frameworks
Providing input to the project plan/release plan, defect/change management processes, systems integration, testing tools and processes;
Identifying areas of weakness to existing procedures, continually implementing new procedures, and assessing risk of impact from changes to projects;
Assisting the IT application team in achieving quality products by identifying defects and deficiencies early and providing feedback for continuously improving the development and testing processes.
Ability to perform manual testing when required.
Skills
Java (OOP principles, Design patterns)
Spring and SpringBoot
Cucumber ( Data Table, Annotations )
Automation framework tools: Selenium, Rest Assured or similar
Rest calls interaction
HTTP protocol understanding
Excellent skills in Test planning, designing, and test strategy/case/script creation and execution.
Experience with integration & regression testing and coordination with supporting systems.
